entries.title: Proverbs 19:1
segments: ¶Better [is] the poor who walks in his integrity Than [one who is] perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:2
segments: ¶Also it is not good [for] a soul [to be] without knowledge, And he sins who hastens with [his] feet.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:3
segments: ¶The foolishness of a man twists his way, And his heart frets against the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:4
segments: ¶Wealth makes many friends, But the poor is separated from his friend.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:5
segments: ¶A false witness will not go unpunished, And [he who] speaks lies will not escape.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:6
segments: ¶Many entreat the favor of the nobility, And every man [is] a friend to one who gives gifts.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:7
segments: All the brothers of the poor hate him; How much more do his friends go far from him! He may pursue [them with] words, [yet] they abandon [him].

entries.title: Proverbs 19:8
segments: ¶He who gets wisdom loves his own soul; He who keeps understanding will find good.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:9
segments: ¶A false witness will not go unpunished, And [he who] speaks lies shall perish.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:10
segments: ¶Luxury is not fitting for a fool, Much less for a servant to rule over princes.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:11
segments: ¶The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger, And his glory [is] to overlook a transgression.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:12
segments: ¶The king's wrath [is] like the roaring of a lion, But his favor [is] like dew on the grass.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:13
segments: ¶A foolish son [is] the ruin of his father, And the contentions of a wife [are] a continual dripping.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:14
segments: ¶Houses and riches [are] an inheritance from fathers, But a prudent wife [is] from the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:15
segments: ¶Laziness casts [one] into a deep sleep, And an idle person will suffer hunger.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:16
segments: ¶He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, [But] he who is careless of his ways will die.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:17
segments: ¶He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD, And He will pay back what he has given.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:18
segments: ¶Chasten your son while there is hope, And do not set your heart on his destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:19
segments: ¶[A man of] great wrath will suffer punishment; For if you rescue [him], you will have to do it again.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:20
segments: ¶Listen to counsel and receive instruction, That you may be wise in your latter days.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:21
segments: ¶There are many plans in a man's heart, Nevertheless the LORD'S counsel-that will stand.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:22
segments: ¶What is desired in a man is kindness, And a poor man is better than a liar.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:23
segments: ¶The fear of the LORD [leads] to life, And [he who has it] will abide in satisfaction; He will not be visited with evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:24
segments: ¶A lazy [man] buries his hand in the bowl, And will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:25
segments: ¶Strike a scoffer, and the simple will become wary; Rebuke one who has understanding, [and] he will discern knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:26
segments: ¶He who mistreats [his] father [and] chases away [his] mother [Is] a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:27
segments: ¶Cease listening to instruction, my son, And you will stray from the words of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:28
segments: ¶A disreputable witness scorns justice, And the mouth of the wicked devours iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:29
segments: ¶Judgments are prepared for scoffers, And beatings for the backs of fools.
